name: Search your documents
blurb: Finds the passages in your documents that best match a question and hands them to your prompt as context.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: the text to search for, usually the customer's question

outputs.name: context
outputs.description: the best-matching passages, each labelled with its document and section

outputs.name: sources
outputs.description: which document and section each passage came from, best first

tunables.name: k
tunables.description: how many passages to hand the prompt (default 4)
